name: group-7-movie-api
description: betechified project # Movie Recommendation API A robust Express.js API designed to manage a movie collection, supporting full CRUD operations. Developed by Group 7 for the BeTechified Capstone Project. # Project Overview This API allows users to manage a movie list without a database, using in-memory data structures to store movie records. It is designed to be clean, readable, and well-documented for easy testing and integration. # Features Create: Add new movie records with details (title, genre, release year, rating). Read: View all movies or filter by specific criteria. Update: Modify existing movie details. Delete: Remove movie records from the system. # Tech Stack Runtime: Node.js Framework: Express.js Testing: Postman # Installation Clone the repository: git clone <your-repo-url>
